test_title: PYST 35: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - GA (Held On: 19 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following events was part of the 15th National Voters' Day celebrations held in January 2025?

options.text: Presentation of best electoral practices awards
Introduction of online voter ID application

solution:
The correct answer is __**Presentation of best electoral practices awards**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The National Voters' Day is celebrated every year on **25th January** to mark the foundation day of the Election Commission of India.
 
• The 15th National Voters' Day in 2025 focused on enhancing voter awareness and celebrating electoral democracy in India.
 
• One of the major highlights of the event was the **presentation of best electoral practices awards** to election officials and institutions for their outstanding contributions.
 
• The awards recognize innovative practices and efforts made to enhance voter participation and ensure free and fair elections.
 
• The event saw the participation of dignitaries, including the Chief Election Commissioner and other election officials, emphasizing the importance of voter empowerment.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Election Commission of India (ECI):**

 
 
• Established on 25th January 1950, the ECI is responsible for administering elections to Parliament, State Legislatures, and the offices of the President and Vice-President of India.
 
• It is a constitutional authority under Article 324 of the Indian Constitution.
 
 
 
• **National Voters' Day:**
 
 
• Started in 2011, it aims to encourage young voters to participate in the electoral process.
 
• The theme of the day varies annually, focusing on voter awareness and engagement.
 
 
 
• **Best Electoral Practices Awards:**
 
 
• These awards are presented annually to election officials and teams for their exemplary work in conducting elections.
 
• The awards cover categories such as voter education, technology implementation, and innovation in election management.
 
 
 
• **Voter Awareness Campaigns:**
 
 
• Initiatives such as SVEEP (Systematic Voters' Education and Electoral Participation) are run by the ECI to increase voter turnout.
 
• These campaigns focus on educating citizens about their electoral rights and responsibilities.
